question: Which among the following is an amphoteric oxide?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Zinc oxide__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zinc oxide** is an amphoteric oxide
 
• **Amphoteric oxide**:
 
 
• ZnO can react with both acids and bases.
 
 
 
• **Reaction with acid**:
 
 
• ZnO reacts with hydrochloric acid (HCl) to produce zinc chloride (ZnCl2) and water.
 
 
 
• **Reaction with base**:
 
 
• ZnO reacts with sodium hydroxide (NaOH) to produce sodium zincate (Na2ZnO2) and water.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Sulphur dioxide (SO2)**

 
 
• Acidic oxide: SO2 reacts with bases to form sulfites.
 
• **For example,** it reacts with sodium hydroxide (NaOH) to produce sodium sulfite (Na2SO3) and water.
 
 
 
• **Magnesium oxide (MgO**)
 
 
• Basic oxide: MgO reacts with acids to form magnesium salts.
 
• **For example,** it reacts with hydrochloric acid (HCl) to produce magnesium chloride (MgCl2) and water.
 
 
 
• **Phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5)**
 
 
• Acidic oxide: P2O5 reacts with bases to form phosphates.
 
• **For example,** it reacts with potassium hydroxide (KOH) to produce potassium phosphate (K3PO4) and water.
